title: Victorian rental safety checks
description: Recurring gas, electrical, smoke alarm and pool checks for a Victorian rental. Summarised from Consumer Affairs Victoria and the Building and Plumbing Commission.

sources.title: Rental providers: gas and electrical safety

items.title: Gas safety check by a licensed gasfitter at least every 2 years
items.detail: Keep the report, including the gas servicing record, until the next check.

items.title: Electrical safety check by a licensed electrician at least every 2 years
items.detail: Keep the AS/NZS 3019 report until the next check.

items.title: Have a gas check done before draughtproofing
Annual smoke alarm safety check
items.detail: Alarms must meet AS 3786. Repair or replace a faulty alarm immediately.

items.title: Tell new renters the dates of the last gas and electrical checks
Give a renter a copy of the latest check within 7 days of a written request
Pool or spa registered with council
Pool barrier inspected every 4 years and certificate lodged with council within 30 days
